messages:
auditor_jane: Hi — running ISO/SOC2 fieldwork next week. We need an evidence bundle that ties RBAC changes (k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding + IAM policy updates) to any KMS decrypt/GenerateDataKey events during the incident window 2025-04-10 04:00 UTC → 2025-04-13 04:00 UTC. Goal: who changed RBAC, which service account or principal performed decryption, key alias used, and chain-of-custody proof (signed manifest + checksums).

sanjay: Quick clarifier: do you want logs for admin console actions (our internal UI) and terraform state changes as well? Those are in a separate audit index.

auditor_jane: Yes, include admin UI and infra-as-code (terraform apply) actions. Prefer raw CSVs plus a redacted set.

maria: Plan to pull: 1) cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant), 2) k8s audit (RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding create/patch/delete), 3) admin-ui audit index, 4) terraform run logs (state changes). Will produce a correlation CSV and signed manifest.

maria: Splunk excerpts i'll run (prod):
```spl
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant)
| eval ts=_time
| table ts, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.ciphertext, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
| sort ts
```

```spl
index=k8s_audit (objectRef.resource=rolebindings OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebindings)
| table _time, user.username, verb, objectRef.resource, objectRef.name, requestObject
```

```spl
index=admin_ui_audit (action=rbac_change OR action=policy_update OR action=emergency_override)
| table _time, user, action, details
```

maria: Correlation approach: time delta (default window +/- 3m), token issuer/origin check (compare OIDC token sub/iss to service-account annotation), matching ip/user-agent, and infra-change reference (terraform run id). Each rule contributes weighted points to correlation_score. We'll include the scoring rules file.

sanjay: Note: ephemeral keys use alias/ephemeral/*; persistent CMKs use alias/prod/*. For EKM/HSM audit logs we have an additional index ekm_audit if auditor requests.

maria: Example pseudo-SQL join I'll create (runs in analytics cluster):
```sql
SELECT
  r._time AS rb_time,
  r.user_username AS rb_actor,
  r.objectRef_resource AS rb_object,
  r.verb AS rb_change_type,
  k.ts AS kms_time,
  k.userIdentity_arn AS kms_actor,
  k.requestParameters_keyId AS key_id,
  k.requestParameters_keyAlias AS key_alias,
  compute_score(r,k,admin,tf) AS correlation_score,
  coalesce(inc.incident_id,'') AS incident_id,
  's3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1834000000/manifest.json.sig' AS manifest_ref
FROM k8s_audit r
LEFT JOIN cloudtrail k ON abs(r._time - k.ts) <= 180
LEFT JOIN admin_ui_audit admin ON admin._time BETWEEN r._time - 300 AND r._time + 300
LEFT JOIN terraform_runs tf ON tf.change_window OVERLAPS r._time
LEFT JOIN incident_index inc ON inc.window CONTAINS r._time;
```

maria: Staging location (unsigned): s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1834000000-keystore-bundle.zip. Contents: cloudtrail.csv, k8s_audit.csv, admin_ui_audit.csv, terraform_runs.csv, correlation.csv, scoring_rules.md, control_map.md, manifest.json. Will sign manifest with KMS signing key alias/signing/for-audit and move to evidence/ on success.

auditor_jane: Please include control mapping to ISO A.8.1.1, A.12.4 and SOC2 CC6.1.2, CC7.1 — we need the artifact IDs for each exported file. Also include retention notes and TTL for logs.

maria: Will add control_map.md mapping each file to control IDs and note retention (CloudTrail 180d, k8s_audit 90d, admin_ui 365d, terraform_runs 365d). Also will include a short README explaining redaction approach (emails -> hashed, IPs last octet masked).

sanjay: Onchain proof: we'll include manifest.json with SHA256 for each file and then create manifest.json.sig using aws-kms sign. Example sign command:
```bash
aws s3 cp ./1834000000-keystore-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/temp/
aws kms sign --key-id alias/signing/for-audit --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.json.sig
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1834000000-keystore-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1834000000-keystore-bundle.zip
```

devops_bot: ALERT: Brief outage recorded (2025-04-11T09:12Z) — scale-controller rolled back 3 deployments. Incident ID INC-20250411-9

auditor_jane: Please ensure incident INC-20250411-9 rows are annotated in correlation.csv and show who committed RBAC rollback and if any GenerateDataKey/Decrypt used ephemeral keys.

maria: Will do. ETA for signed evidence bundle: ~5 hours. I'll DM the S3 presigned link to auditor_jane when ready. We'll also include a small sanitized sample row in the README. Sample sanitized row: 
"rbac_1715801020 | bob@redwood (redacted) | RoleBinding:scale-controller | patch | kms_1715801100 | svc-account-scale | key/abcd-xxxx | alias/ephemeral/scale | 0.88 | INC-20250411-9 | s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1834000000/manifest.json.sig"

auditor_jane: Excellent — thanks. We'll validate and follow up if we need ekm logs. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
